config_coupling.effect: Ordinary authority transactions use NORMAL. Durable admission pins a connection, sets FULL before BEGIN and verifies level 2 before proceeding. Release restores NORMAL; if restoration fails, it discards the connection rather than returning it to the pool.
config_coupling.source: The authority DSN uses the compile-time synchronous constant NORMAL. BeginWrite selects FULL only for durable admission; releaseDurableConn resets that connection to NORMAL. These are fixed code values, not an environment override.
